newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar settles unchanged in light volume.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar settles unchanged in light volume.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed a thinly traded session unchanged.
But the benchmark October contract managed to hold its downside target of 11.00 cents a lb for the second straight session, leading some market sources to forecast near-term gains.
"(The market) has taken some selling and the trade seems to want to buy it here," a sugar broker said. "I wouldn't be surprised to see it bounce."
Steady trade buying was noted from 11.05 cents in October, while light commission house selling was cited at the highs.
Volume was thin at an estimated 7,653 lots against Monday's official 8,691 lots.
Most-active October settled at 11.06 cents after trading from 11.12 to 11.05 cents. The rest closed flat and 0.01 cent firmer.
Open interest in October fell 466 lots to 93,812 lots as of Monday. March's open interest rose 18 lots to 42,047 lots.
Traders said October sugar could remain in a range between 11.00 and 11.22 cents without a nudge from the fundamental side.
